newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ISCOR SHARES FUELLED BY FIRM INDUSTRIALS.
newsitem.headline: ISCOR SHARES FUELLED BY FIRM INDUSTRIALS.

text.p: Jubilant South African industrial stocks and hopes for richer iron and steel prices drew shares in Iscor higher amid robust volumes on Monday.
By 1030 GMT Iscor was 11 cents or 3.32 percent higher at 342 cents with 1.33 million shares having been traded.
The share climbed as high as 343 cents at one stage from its opening price of 332 cents.

Dealers said the large number of shares changing hands in Iscor were mainly due to a feeling that the stock had been oversold last week. Reports commodity prices might be on the move up were also offering encouragement.
But dealers said the impact of the powering industrial index should not be ignored and Iscor was riding the strong wave.
"The whole industrial market is booming. Then there was this newspaper report a short while back saying that iron and steel prices had hit the botttom and were on their way up.
"The whole market has picked up and Iscor has enough incentive to jump. The shares were pretty much oversold last week and now they're being bought," one dealer said.
